description: Get statistical aggregations for market analysis. Billed per aggregation returned. Aggregations: count, sum, mean, median, mode, min, max, quantile-10, quantile-25, quantile-40, quantile-60, quantile-75, quantile-80, quantile-85, quantile-90, quantile-95, quantile-99. Text and boolean fields only support count and mode, and only fields field_detail marks aggregatable are accepted. count counts the properties that hold a value for the field, so a count per country measures how well a field is covered there. Ask for several statistics in one call with the aggregations array instead of one call each. Every statistic must name exactly one country, with country_abbreviation, or something narrower inside one country, on the call or on its own entry, and different entries may name different countries. A bounding box or a polygon alone is not enough, and a call with a statistic that names no place, or more than one country, is refused with a 400.

AggregateRequest.description: One statistic inside an aggregate_endpoint batch.

aggregation.description: Aggregation type: count, sum, mean, median, mode, min, max, or quantile-10 through quantile-99 from the fixed list. Text and boolean fields only support count and mode.

city.description: City for this statistic only, which is how you compare two cities in one request. Defaults to the call's city.

community.description: Community for this statistic only. Defaults to the call's community.

country_abbreviation.description: Country abbreviation for this statistic only. Defaults to the call's country_abbreviation.

exclude.description: Source classes to leave out of this statistic only, such as "inferred". Defaults to the call's exclude.

field.description: Field to aggregate. Use field_list to discover available fields.

filters.description: Extra filters for this statistic only. These are applied on top of the call's filters.

province_abbreviation.description: Province/state abbreviation for this statistic only. Defaults to the call's province_abbreviation.

aggregation.description: Aggregation type for the single-statistic form: count, sum, mean, median, mode, min, max, quantile-10, quantile-25, quantile-40, quantile-60, quantile-75, quantile-80, quantile-85, quantile-90, quantile-95 or quantile-99. Those quantiles are the only ones that exist.

aggregations.description: Several statistics in one request, instead of one call each. Each entry gets its own field and aggregation, and inherits this call's location and filters unless it sets its own. Do not also set field.

bbox_ne_lat.description: Bounding box northeast latitude. All four bbox values are required together.

bbox_ne_lng.description: Bounding box northeast longitude. All four bbox values are required together.

bbox_sw_lat.description: Bounding box southwest latitude. All four bbox values are required together.

bbox_sw_lng.description: Bounding box southwest longitude. All four bbox values are required together.

city.description: City name. Requires country_abbreviation and province_abbreviation, and the request is refused with a 400 error if either is missing.

community.description: Community/neighborhood name. Requires country_abbreviation, province_abbreviation and city.

country_abbreviation.description: Country abbreviation as location_endpoint returns it (for example "CA"). Any letter case is accepted. Every statistic needs a place, so pass it here or on each entry of aggregations.

exclude.description: Source classes to leave out of the aggregation, comma separated: "inferred" leaves out every value Houski worked out, and "inferred,observed" keeps only values from a linked public record. Applies to a field with a source column, and the answer's values_used counts the values each statistic used. In the aggregations form every entry inherits it unless it sets its own.

field.description: Field to aggregate for a single statistic. Use field_list to discover available fields. Leave this out when using aggregations.

filters.description: Filters array. Format: "field_operator=value", with the value as plain text and not URL encoded. Use search_api_documentation for reference.

polygon.description: Polygon coordinates "lat_lng,lat_lng,lat_lng", latitude and longitude joined by an underscore. Maximum 100 points, simplify a shape that has more.

price_quote.description: Return the cost of this request without billing it or returning data

province_abbreviation.description: Province, state or region abbreviation as location_endpoint returns it (for example "AB"). Requires country_abbreviation.

name: aggregate_endpoint
